reason: Pre-science completeness audit found that the locked Repair25 implementation covered the frozen routing gates but did not yet emit every explicitly requested convention diagnostic: raw complex amplitudes/magnitudes/phases/ratios, complex least-squares scales, v0.77 Q_trace closure, and the full declared frozen-convention factor set.
